body_html:
The Offices To Go Craft Wedge Overtable turns soft lounge seating into a functional work or dining surface without crowding the floor. Its wedge-shaped thermally fused laminate top slides over Craft modular ottomans and units, giving people a place to set a laptop, a coffee or a lunch tray in casual breakout, breakroom and cafeteria settings. Lightweight chrome wire legs make the whole piece easy to reposition as the room changes.

Features

  • Wedge-shaped top designed to sit over Craft modular lounge and ottoman seating
  • Durable 11/16" thermally fused laminate surface in Absolute Acajou (available in all Ionic finishes)
  • 1/2" solid steel wire legs in a polished chrome finish
  • Factory-installed clear glides protect floors and ease repositioning
  • Lightweight and easy to move for flexible, reconfigurable layouts
  • Coordinates with the full Craft modular collection to build collaborative zones
  • Made in Canada; ships unassembled in one carton

Specifications

Measures 26" deep by 19" high with a wedge-profile top. Materials meet applicable ANSI/BIFMA standards and carry a 5-year limited warranty on non-moving parts. Assembly is not included.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964, 296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and finish matching, or call 1-800-835-9565.
